reasons: The student's limit of 4 MC per semester is too low to complete the 7 required modules (total 28 MC) within the remaining 4 semesters (Y2S1-Y3S2), which can hold at most 80 MC but requires taking at least 7 modules. More critically, prerequisites force a sequence: CS3237 (Sem 1) -> CS4247 (Sem 2) and CS2103T (Sem 1/2) -> CS3241 (Sem 1). CS3230 and CS2105 have no specific semester restrictions but need prerequisites. The main blocker is the MC limit: 7 modules * 4 MC = 28 MC. Even if spread over 4 semesters, average is 7 MC/sem. With a 4 MC limit, max modules per sem is 1 (4 MC). 4 semesters * 1 module = 4 modules. 4 < 7. Impossible to fit all required modules.
